name: Sam's 10-team full-PPR keeper league (2026)
notes: Two divisions, head-to-head; regular season weeks 1-14; playoffs weeks 15-17 (top 6, top-2 seeds bye week 15); no games week 18.
No kickers. TE is flex-only (W/R/T). One team DEF + one IDP (any DL/LB/DB).

Scoring: full PPR confirmed. Everything else here is Yahoo's default (4-pt pass TD, -1 INT, -2 fumble lost, 0.04/yd passing, 0.1/yd rush+rec, IDP tackle 1 / assist 0.5 / sack 2 / INT 3 / FF 2 / FR 2 / TD 6 / safety 2 / PD 1 / block 2) — confirm against the Yahoo settings page and edit 'scoring' if the league differs.

SCORING VALUES THAT MOVE RANKINGS MOST (check these first on Yahoo): (1) pass_td 4 vs 6 — at 6 every QB gains ~40-60 pts and the whole QB tier climbs several rounds; (2) pass_int -1 vs -2 shuffles gunslinger QBs; (3) IDP balance — tackle-heavy (tackle_solo 1+) makes LBs the top IDPs, big-play-heavy (sack 3-4, def_int 4+) flips to DL/DB, so the 'which IDP to take late' answer depends on it; (4) rec 1.0 full-PPR is confirmed, but if TEs got a premium (rec 1.5 for TE) the flex-only TE calculus changes. Re-run setup-league after any edit.

Keepers: rounds 1-3 picks can't be kept; up to 4 keepers; cost = last year's round - 3 (2025 Rd 9 -> 2026 Rd 6); undrafted keepers cost Rd 15 (extra undrafted keepers fill Rd 14/16/17). Enter every team's keepers under 'keepers' as {slot: [{player, round}]} once they're due (Sep 1, 2026).

Draft: Fri Sep 4 2026, 7:15pm ET, Yahoo online snake, 1:45 per pick. Set draft.my_slot when the order is known, and optionally 'teams' {slot: manager name} so the manual-entry team picker shows real names.
